recipe_steps: Add 1 cup rolled oats to a blender and blend on high for 30 seconds until a fine flour forms.
Add 2 eggs, 1 peeled banana, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 cup milk to the blender. Blend 45 seconds until smooth; let batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium (about 350F). Melt 1/2 tbsp butter to coat.
Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form and edges set, then flip and cook 1-2 minutes more until golden.
Repeat with remaining butter and batter. Stack, top with 2 tbsp maple syrup, and serve immediately.
Spoon 1.5 cups Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 3/4 cup mixed berries and 2 tbsp sliced almonds.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and eat immediately.
Cut 8 oz chicken breast into 1-inch cubes and pat dry.
Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, minced garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high (about 400F). Add chicken and sear 5-6 minutes, turning, until browned and 165F internal.
Steam 1 cup broccoli in the microwave with 2 tbsp water for 2 minutes.
Pour sauce into the skillet with the chicken; simmer 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.
Reheat 1.5 cups rice, top with chicken, broccoli, and sesame seeds. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move an 8 oz portion of chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw for Monday lunch.
Rinse 2 cups dry white rice, cook with 3 cups water; cool and refrigerate for use across early-week bowls.

recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread until golden.
Spread 3/4 cup cottage cheese evenly across both slices.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and sprinkle 1 tsp chia seeds. Eat immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Mix 3 cups whole wheat flour, 1 cup warm water, 1 packet (2.25 tsp) yeast, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp oil, 1.5 tsp salt. Knead 10 min, rise 1 hr, shape into loaf pan, rise 45 min, bake at 375F for 35 min. Cool and store for the week's toasts.

meals.recipe_name: Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter Quinoa
recipe_steps: Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa; simmer with 1.5 cups water for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Pat salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400F). Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip, cook 3 minutes to 125F internal.
Remove salmon. Lower heat, add 2 tbsp butter and minced garlic; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Snap asparagus into the pan and saute 3 minutes in the garlic butter.
Fold half the garlic butter into the quinoa. Plate salmon over quinoa with asparagus, squeeze lemon over top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move an 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw for Monday dinner.

recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Add 4 oz ground turkey and 1/2 tsp cumin; cook 5 minutes breaking apart until browned to 165F.
Whisk 3 eggs, pour into the pan, and scramble with the turkey 2-3 minutes until just set.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortilla with egg-turkey mix, 1/3 cup warmed black beans, 1/4 cup cheddar, and 2 tbsp salsa.
Fold sides in, roll tight, and sear seam-side down 1 minute. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday breakfast.
Mix 2 cups flour, 3/4 cup warm water, 3 tbsp oil, 1 tsp salt. Knead 5 min, rest covered 1 hr, divide into 6 balls, refrigerate. Roll and dry-cook each as needed.

recipe_steps: Drain the tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix in 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tsp dijon, a squeeze of lemon, and black pepper.
Halve the cucumber lengthwise and scoop out seeds to form boats.
Fill cucumber halves with tuna salad and eat immediately.
Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, minced garlic in a bowl.
Toss 7 oz thin-sliced beef in the marinade (see prep task).
Heat a skillet over high (450F). Add marinated beef in a single layer; sear 2 minutes per side until caramelized.
Julienne 1 carrot; add to pan and stir-fry 1 minute.
Reheat 1.5 cups rice, top with beef and carrots, garnish with sliced green onion and sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz sliced sirloin from freezer to fridge Monday morning. Monday night combine with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 cloves minced garlic; marinate 12-18 hrs.

recipe_steps: Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1/4 cup oats to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately.
Boil linguine in salted water 9 minutes until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter over medium-high. Add shrimp, cook 90 seconds per side until pink; remove.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes to the pan; cook 30 seconds.
Pour in 1/4 cup white wine and simmer 2 minutes to reduce by half.
Add remaining 1 tbsp butter, a splash of pasta water, and lemon juice; swirl to emulsify.
Return shrimp and pasta, toss with parsley and parmesan. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp in a sealed bag Tuesday evening, ~20 min, changing water once.

recipe_steps: Whisk 3 eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium. Add 1 cup spinach and halved tomatoes; wilt 2 minutes, then set aside.
Pour eggs into the pan; as they set, lift edges to let raw egg flow under, about 2 minutes.
Spoon 1/2 cup cottage cheese and the veggies onto one half; fold over and cook 1 minute.
Serve with 1 toasted slice of whole wheat bread.
Layer half the Greek yogurt in a glass.
Add half the granola and half the berries.
Repeat layers, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey, and eat immediately.
Julienne carrot and cucumber; toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of salt to quick-pickle while cooking.
Slice 7 oz pork tenderloin into medallions; season with salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high (400F). Sear pork 3 minutes per side to 145F internal; rest 3 minutes.
Whisk 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp sriracha; brush over pork.
Reheat 1.5 cups rice, top with pork, pickled veg, and cilantro. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch.
Day-of, julienne 1 carrot and 1/2 cucumber, toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and pinch salt; sit 15 min while cooking.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Dice 1 apple and add on top with 2 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Sprinkle 1/2 tsp cinnamon and drizzle 1 tbsp honey. Eat immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Bison Burger with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp oil, paprika, and salt; roast 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Form 8 oz bison into a patty, season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat 1/2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear patty 4 minutes, flip, add cheddar, cook 3 minutes to 145F internal.
Toast the bun cut-side down 1 minute.
Build burger with lettuce, tomato, and patty. Serve with sweet potato wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner.
Mix 3 cups flour, 1 cup warm milk, 1 packet yeast, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 egg, 3 tbsp butter, 1 tsp salt. Knead 8 min, rise 1 hr, form 8 buns, freeze. Thaw Wednesday morning and warm before use.

recipe_steps: Whisk 3 eggs. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low.
Add eggs and stir gently, folding curds for 3 minutes until soft-set.
Fold in 3 oz torn smoked salmon and chives; cook 30 seconds more.
Toast 2 slices bread, spread with 2 tbsp cream cheese, top with scramble. Serve.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 banana to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and drink immediately.
Slice 8 oz chicken into strips; toss with chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high. Sear chicken 6 minutes to 165F; remove.
Add 1/2 tbsp oil, sliced pepper and onion; saute 5 minutes until charred.
Warm 1/2 cup black beans and 1.25 cups rice.
Assemble bowl with rice, chicken, peppers, beans, cheddar, and a squeeze of lime.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch.
Cook 1.5 cups dry white rice with 2.25 cups water Wednesday; cool, refrigerate for Thursday/Friday bowls.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1.25 cups Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 2 tbsp chopped walnuts, drizzle 1 tbsp honey, dust with cinnamon. Eat immediately.
Cook 3/4 cup jasmine rice with 1.25 cups water, 15 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high. Add minced garlic and sliced chili; stir 20 seconds.
Add 8 oz ground turkey; stir-fry 5 minutes breaking apart to 165F.
Add chopped green beans; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp brown sugar; toss 1 minute.
Kill heat, fold in 1/2 cup basil until wilted. Serve over rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner.

recipe_steps: Whisk 2 eggs, 1/3 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, and cinnamon into a custard.
Dip each bread slice 10 seconds per side to soak.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium (350F). Cook slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with 2 tbsp maple syrup.
Drain tuna, mash with 1/2 avocado, lemon juice, and pepper.
Spoon onto 8 crackers and eat immediately.
Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water into a sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high. Sear beef 2 minutes until browned; remove.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and broccoli with 2 tbsp water; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Return beef, add sauce, toss 2 minutes until thickened.
Serve over 1.25 cups reheated rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz sliced sirloin from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch.

recipe_steps: Add cottage cheese, milk, frozen mango, whey, and honey to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and drink immediately.
Bring 2.5 cups water and 1/2 cup milk to a boil; whisk in 3/4 cup grits, reduce to low, cook 18 minutes stirring often.
Stir 1/3 cup cheddar and 1 tbsp butter into grits; keep warm.
Toss shrimp with 1 tbsp cajun seasoning.
Melt 1 tbsp butter over medium-high, add garlic, then shrimp; cook 90 seconds per side until pink.
Spoon grits into a bowl, top with shrimp and sliced green onion. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp in a sealed bag Friday afternoon, ~20 min, changing water once.

recipe_steps: Dice potato small; heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium, add potato with paprika and salt, cook 12 minutes crisp, stirring.
Season steak with salt; heat 1/2 tbsp oil in a second pan over high, sear 2 minutes per side, rest 3 min.
In the potato pan, push fries aside, add 1 tbsp butter, fry 3 eggs to preference.
Plate steak, eggs, and home fries. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz sliced sirloin from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and drink immediately.
Season 6 oz ground turkey with salt and pepper; form into a thin patty.
Cook patty in a skillet over medium-high 4 minutes per side to 165F.
Spread 2 tbsp pesto on bread; layer patty, mozzarella, and tomato.
Brush outside with 1 tbsp oil, grill in a press or pan 3 minutes per side until crisp and cheese melts. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch.

recipe_steps: Thaw 1/2 cup mango 2 minutes in microwave, dice.
Spoon 1.25 cups Greek yogurt into a bowl, top with mango, chia seeds, and honey. Eat immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Herb-Crusted Roast Chicken Thighs with Couscous
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Pat chicken thighs dry, rub with 1 tbsp oil, minced garlic, rosemary, and salt.
Sear thighs skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet 4 minutes, then transfer skillet to oven 18 minutes to 175F internal.
Slice zucchini; saute in 1/2 tbsp oil 4 minutes.
Boil 3/4 cup water, stir in 3/4 cup couscous with 1/2 tbsp oil, cover off heat 5 minutes, fluff.
Plate chicken over couscous with zucchini, squeeze lemon. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.

recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium. Saute diced onion and pepper 5 minutes.
Add cumin and paprika, cook 30 seconds, then add 1 cup crushed tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes.
Make 3 wells, crack an egg into each, cover, cook 6 minutes until whites set.
Crumble 1/4 cup feta over top. Serve with 2 toasted bread slices.
Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with berries, almonds, and honey. Eat immediately.
Pat salmon dry, season lightly. Sear in a hot pan over high 3 minutes per side to 125F, then flake into chunks.
Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp rice vinegar.
Reheat 1.25 cups rice into a bowl.
Top with salmon, diced cucumber, avocado, green onion, sesame seeds; drizzle sauce. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch.

recipe_steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Chop with Apple Cider Glaze & Mashed Potato
recipe_steps: Boil peeled, cubed potatoes 15 minutes until tender; mash with 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, salt.
Slice 8 oz pork tenderloin into medallions, season with salt, pepper, thyme.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, sear pork 3 minutes per side to 145F; remove.
Add diced apple, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp butter to the pan; simmer 4 minutes into a glaze.
Return pork to coat. Plate over mashed potatoes with glaze. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner.
